answer: A hostile operator running 150 aliases thus needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in jade, expire in ledge, and ripple lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2276 identities would post 1751 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
